item.title: Lass Words: First impressions
item.description: Did you ever notice that when you first meet someone, you usually develop an immediate impression about them? They strike you in a certain way.

item.title: First Baptist Church Garden City hosting revival Feb. 22–25
item.description: First Baptist Church Garden City is having revival Feb. 22–25. Sunday’s service begins at 10:30 a.m., and weekdays at 6:30 p.m.

item.title: Pastor assaulted for inviting children to church
item.description: A pastor preparing for an all-night prayer service at his church was attacked in late December and left badly injured and unconscious.

item.title: FBC Geraldine welcomes new associate pastor
item.description: Ryan Jordan is the new associate pastor of worship and administration for First Baptist Church Geraldine.

item.title: First person: 10 critical points to assimilation for every church
item.description: The act of complete absorption and integration of people, ideas or culture into a wider society or culture. This is the definition of assimilation.

item.title: Many churches will waste Easter opportunity. Here’s why.
item.description: Just before Easter, the pressure starts to build. Extra services get added. Easter and church graphics are refreshed. Social media calendars fill up. Volunteers are recruited.

item.title: Alabama House passes Sarah Marsh Heaven’s 27 Camp Safety Act
item.description: The Alabama House of Representatives unanimously passed the Sarah Marsh Heaven’s 27 Camp Safety Act on Tuesday.

item.title: Lass Words: A ‘puzzling virtue’ — humility
item.description: To me, the most puzzling virtue in the Bible is humility. I have spent many moments trying to figure out exactly what it is. I want to have it, but isn’t wanting to be humble the opposite of actually being humble?

item.title: Not forgotten: College students lead live worship for inmates
item.description: Inmates at correctional facilities in Mobile and Baldwin Counties recently participated in worship services with live music provided by students from the University of Mobile (UM).
